prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape essay cover for a restrained personal blog, approximately 1.9:1 aspect ratio.
Primary request: an understated abstract editorial illustration about the paradox of benevolence: a kind intention can cast a harmful unintended consequence, so good will needs careful judgment.
Scene/backdrop: uninterrupted warm ivory paper (#F4F1EA).
Subject: a simplified muted sage silhouette of an open, gently cupped hand offering one small round seed. Below and slightly beyond it, the hand's soft form casts a contrasting flat charcoal shadow with one pointed angular edge that reaches toward a separate small dusty-clay circle. Show the mismatch between the rounded caring gesture and its unintended sharp shadow. The circle must remain intact: no injury or violence, just a quiet visual risk. Keep the hand reduced to one elegant continuous shape with almost no finger detail, not realistic anatomy.
Style/medium: sophisticated minimalist cut-paper editorial illustration, flat silhouettes and subtly imperfect organic edges, extremely subtle print grain.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal canvas, a compact central arrangement occupying the middle half, ample warm ivory negative space; the hand, seed, angular shadow and separate circle remain within the central 60 percent and legible at thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: gentle but questioning, contemplative and responsible; low contrast and no dramatic lighting.
Color palette: warm ivory #F4F1EA; muted sage #A5B1A0 hand and seed; dusty clay #C9A18F separate circle; desaturated charcoal #414846 shadow used sparingly.
Constraints: four meaningful primary forms only; no text, letters, numbers, formulas, labels, logos, watermark, border, title, literal heart, flowers, arrows, halos, weapons, distressed people, busy scenery, saturated colors, glossy 3D or photographic realism. Produce the illustration only.
alt_en: A gentle offering hand casts a pointed shadow toward an unintended recipient.
alt_ko: 부드럽게 무언가를 건네는 손의 뾰족한 그림자가 다른 대상에 닿는 모습으로 선의와 결과의 간극을 표현한다.
concept: The English and Korean originals distinguish benevolent motives from consequences and demand empirical calibration. A caring rounded hand with an unexpectedly pointed shadow expresses unintended harm without showing injury.

inspection.notes: Viewed generated asset at full resolution; restrained palette, no embedded text, central metaphor legible and landscape aspect ratio suitable for the blog.
